summary:
A self-driven Software Engineer with 3 years of experience in developing high-performance web applications
using PHP, SQL. Skilled in building scalable backend systems, implementing secure role-based access control,
and contributing across the full SDLC. Strong team collaborator with a focus on clean code, performance
optimization, and delivering reliable, impactful software solutions.

bullets: Developed core backend features including order processing, currency handling, coupons, and pricing rules
Built and integrated admin panel functionalities such as product, category, order, user, and coupon management.
Implemented end-to-end e-commerce workflows, covering the entire user journey from cart management and checkout processing to secure order confirmation and system-level order handling.
Created a custom coupon/discount engine supporting percentage, fixed-amount, and product-level rules using Laravel framework.
Worked on Laravel projects, developing scalable backend systems, RESTful APIs, and implementing business logic using MVC architecture.

pre_date_header: Software Developer, Samarth Egov – New Delhi
bullets: Developed and maintained web applications using PHP (Yii2 Framework) and SQL, contributing across the full software development lifecycle.
Designed and implemented Role-Based Access Control (RBAC) and Approval Hierarchy systems, enhancing workflow efficiency and permission security.
Optimized application performance and page speed using caching, query optimization.
Built full-stack features by designing and integrating front-end (HTML, CSS, JavaScript), back-end logic (PHP), and database schemas SQL.
Explored and implemented advanced features like Job Queues and Dynamic PDF generation for large-scale reporting.
Worked in agile teams, collaborating with designers, testers, and backend engineers to deliver high-quality, scalable software within deadlines.

jobs.role: Software Engineer, Thinkway Industries Pvt Ltd
pre_date_header: Software Engineer, Thinkway Industries Pvt Ltd – New Delhi
bullets: Collaborated in a team to build a healthcare web application allowing patients to book appointments and doctors to manage medical records, using PHP with SQL for the backend.
Took ownership of the frontend development, implementing of role-based authentication.
Integrated RESTful PHP APIs with the frontend using Axios, enabling secure data exchange and efficient real-time appointment handling.
Ensured seamless performance and stability across modules with multithreading and unit testing.
Participated in testing and debugging to ensure smooth functionality across different user roles.
Completed 6 weeks of Core JAVA training by submitting the capstone project on JAVA.
